notes.title: BoxVR just got its biggest update ever!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce a massive new FREE content update for BoxVR out today, adding 12 new workouts and over 140 minutes of brand new music.

Based on popular player requests, BoxVR will receive over 40 new music tracks spanning across a wealth of genres, including 80s Electro, Rock and Metal.

Opening up voting to our community, we asked you what new types of music you wanted to work up a sweat to, and after a tremendous response on social media, the top picks are now being added in this major update.

These tracks will be introduced with 12 new, adrenaline-pumping workouts utilizing the music to create electrifying routines to burn it up.

And the best bit? It’s all available to you for free - just make sure your headset is connected to the internet and your BoxVR game should update automatically.

Ianthe, our Head of Fitness, has also crafted a fitness challenge for January. Each day we’ll hero a class of the day, progressively getting harder and longer throughout the month. Keep an eye on our social channels to take part!

notes.title: BoxVR Patch - 14th June 2019
notes.notes:
Hey Champs,

Today we release a patch for the PC versions of BoxVR to fix some issues that were reported to us from the community and to make some small changes. Please read on to see a list of the changes in this release.

Changes

Replaced the icon pack that was previously used with the intended selection of avatars.


Fixes

Fixed the music processor - it should now process .m4a and .ogg files correctly as well as .mp3 files
Fixed the folder/file view in ‘My Workouts’ reverting to the default view, it will now remember to return to the previously used folder to make things easier when adding multiple tracks.
Fixed the ‘Weekly Calories’ counter on the Main Menu from resetting on a daily basis.
Fixed the stats of the previous profile from remaining on the Main Menu after changing to a different profile.
Fixed the multiplier in older environments so it now correctly informs you of which multiplier you have during a workout - previously it was stuck on 1x

notes.title: BoxVR Full Release
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29162037/410ecbc5bd5c6bd1e14d995da38fc9346327841e.jpg

Hey Champs,

It’s here! The end of Early Access as we bring you the long-awaited update to BoxVR for PC. In this update, we hope BoxVR feels like a new and fresh experience for you to achieve your fitness goals while also having a fun and immersive time doing so. Read on to find out more about what’s new in BoxVR.

New Locker Room

Starting up BoxVR you will be presented with the new Locker Room, now with added music playing in the background (or is it a class that is already taking place?) helping you to get yourselves ready and in the mindset for some kcal burning. You’ll also notice a re-design of the Main Menu that will allow you to quickly get to any section you desire via the Menu buttons on the left-hand side.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29162037/d3c86eb0fb4157f85175e8cd22f76419bb8c47ec.png

New and Improved Workouts

With this update, we are happy to bring you 15 more workouts to BoxVR, totaling the number of workouts to 45 across various timeframes and intensities. You’ll also notice that there are no longer ‘Rest Periods’ during a workout, these have been replaced with what we refer to as ‘Active Rests’. During these Active Rests, you’ll notice the intensity of the workout reducing for an amount of time before returning to a more complex and intense workout. This will help keep your heart rate up and active while also providing a few moments to catch your breath.

New Environments

After choosing your workout, you’ll notice three new environments to choose from:

the Day Gym
the Night Gym
the Future level

Some people enjoy working up a sweat during the day while other nighthawks prefer the solitude of night, and then there are some who are looking towards the “future”. Whichever person you may be, now you have a new selection of Gyms to choose from as well as the previous themed areas we have provided in the past. 

New Music Tracks

With a bunch of new workouts being added, it was necessary to fill those workouts with some new music tracks for you to bop and beat the cues to. With these new tracks in BoxVR, bringing the total number to 110, we’re sure you’ll find a new favorite. On top of that, all the tracks provided in BoxVR can be used in the ‘My Workouts’ mode (the new name for ‘Training’) where you can place them into playlists

All Workouts in Multiplayer

Previously in BoxVR, there was only a selection of workouts to be used in Multiplayer lobbies. With this new update, you will have access to all available Workouts that we have created to be used in Multiplayer, so if you're looking for a quick session with friends or going for a full 60 minutes and challenging each other's top scores, you'll have a wealth of workouts to do so with now.

notes.title: PC Update Progress Report
notes.notes:
Hello all,

As you may have seen, we released a version of BoxVR on the PS4 system yesterday (Apr 30th). At this point in time you might be thinking “Wait a minute, why don’t we have the update? We were here first.” which is completely understandable. 

This version will be coming to the PC platform on both the Steam and Oculus stores shortly as we finalize some of the features which are slightly different to what is currently live on PlayStation.

Achievements

Within the PlayStation version of BoxVR you are able to unlock Trophies relating to your performance and progress, we want to bring these same achievements over to PC so players don’t feel left out and also have something other than just your fitness goals to aim for. It is possible that we may have to add these in a later update if it will take more time than we desire to get this new update live. We aim to keep you updated regarding this.

Survival

Right now, the ‘Survival’ mode is not available in the PlayStation version of BoxVR as we came to a decision that it can give the wrong message that we are trying to convey. We aren’t trying to overexert anyone and an ‘endless’ mode can lead to that. However, since Survival is currently available on Steam and Oculus, we feel it would be insincere of us to remove features that we have made available previously. There are a few more changes needed for it to correctly function in the new environments and HUD.

Profile system

In the PlayStation version, profiles are directly tied to the system profiles which is not the case on PC, where you can create multiple profiles. At this moment in time there a few bugs surrounding this part of BoxVR that we want to eliminate before release purely from a polish and feel perspective.

Once we have eliminated these issues and it has passed our quality assurance tests, both the Steam and Oculus store versions will be updated to the new version. It has been a while since we released an update to these platforms so we thank you tremendously for your patience while we worked on this update and look forward to hearing what you think of all the new features, workouts and tracks.

notes.title: New workout with this update (v0.23)
notes.notes:
We have just updated the live version with 3 new workout with new music. 

 Welcome Workout - a new workout to get new players into the rhythm.
 Hip Hop Hook - Your quads are going to be burning afterwards.
 Pop Punch - Feel the heat with this intense all punch combo workout!

Also, we have updated the default cue set.The change comes as we continued to evaluate your feedback here and from hit data. We feel this set is more distinguishable from a distance, feels better to punch and also aid with on-boarding new players.

Lastly, we have fixed bugs and also addressed some performance issue experienced by some players. 

Enjoy

- The FitXR Team

Note: A small update on 7 Aug to fix a bug affecting new users.

notes.title: Update v0.19 - Multiplayer, Profiles and more
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that we are pushing v0.19 live from beta.

The key features in this build include


 Profiles: Create profiles for all users of BOXVR on your machine
 Multiplayer: Create a lobby of upto 6 players. Workout in a group, or invite your friends to a hiscore match.
 Playlists in Train mode: Create playlists with multiple songs to make longer training workouts
 Itunes Support : Support for AAC file format added


The build also contains tweaks and bug fixes from feedback from the community. 

We continue to work on improvements and new content. Thank you for supporting us with your feedback and comments.

- The FitXR Team

notes.title: Refinements to hit and calorie counter (patch for v0.15)
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce a patch to v0.15, with revisions to both hit detection and dynamic calorie counter.

We would like to apologise for any issues that some of our users have been experiencing since the last update. We believe that these new systems will work significantly better as we continue to refine them, and all BOXVR players will enjoy them.

As always we really appreciate your continued support and feedback to help make BOXVR as awesome as it can be. We wouldn't be here without you all.

-The FitXR team

notes.title: Hit Feedback Update (v0.11.6586)
notes.notes:
Happy new year 2018!

We have been working hard on a fix for the hit detection issues that some of our users had faced. This update should provide a consistent hit feedback experience across a wide range of hardware configurations.

We have disabled the tutorial in this build while we rework it for the updated hit system. We will release a patch early next week to renable the tutorial mode.

To everyone who had hit issues - please try this release and let us know how it's working out. 

Thank you for your comments and reviews over the holiday period. We are very glad to see the positive impact BOXVR has had on so many people. We look forward to bringing improvements and updates regularly.

Best wishes  
- the FitXR Team

notes.title: Happy Holidays! (new update v0.7.6565)
notes.notes:
Hello!

This update contains a special treat  - a winter environment for the Holidays! We hope you enjoy the chilly workouts!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29162037/5cd9a92c1aaa312de45c2cc56eea9efe4ad372e6.png

We have  been working on improving hit feedback for this build. Together with last week's hook and uppercut punch response changes, we hope this improves your workout experience. Here's how the hit feedback works
- Stronger hits are rewarded a bigger score
- A score popup lets you know the score for the hit (between 10 to 50). The multiplier is applied to this score for the final score on the Scoreboard 
- The score popup is color coded : Green for strong punches, Blue for medium strength punches, and Yellow for a simple hit. (Note that the explosion particles have been reacting to punch strength for a while now)

We have also put in fixes for the calorie count and workout stat bugs and several other bug fixes and improvements. 

Thank you for using BOXVR and sharing your amazing stories with us. We are constantly inspired by your feedback and comments and look forward to more.

Wish you a very happy holiday season!

notes.title: Update - Recenter room based on player position (v0.3.31)
notes.notes:
We are pleased to release the latest update with the ability to recenter the game experience based on the player's physical position (a popular request). You can do this from the Settings menu. 

The update also fixes the Windows 7 bug for Train mode where some songs were not loading beyond 70%.

We are working away towards balancing gameplay and adding polish. Please continue to give us your feedback and reviews.

notes.title: Another MASSIVE release (V0.3.14)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29162037/31bb75d916b44071bc1f31bd857cde9e7d8daee7.png

The team at FitXR (yes minor name change) is proud to announce another massive release. 

We have been working hard recently and are very pleased to announce the first iteration of Survival mode. We have partnered with Melodrive, an AI powered adaptive music system, to produce the music for Survival mode.

Other updates include:
New tutorial – hopefully this makes a big difference for new users 
New beginner workouts – please try them out and let us know what you think
Super Endurance - our longest workout ever
Various bug fixes for Train mode 
New gym and locker room environments
New UI throughout 
We have another big update planned for next week with a completely revised leaderboard. You will note that leaderboards have been disabled while we work on this so please bear with us. 

Please keep your reviews, comments and feedback coming - you all give us the inspiration to keep making BOXVR better!!!

notes.title: Train with your own music files ! - Update v0.2.10
notes.notes:
The team at FITAR is proud to announce our biggest update till date that includes some of your key feedback and input

    Training Mode - It's finally here! You can select MP3 and WAV files from your PC and train in 3 difficulty levels. Training Mode took a lot of work - beat detection on the fly was a challenge, and we wanted to ensure that it stayed true to BOXVR -  delivering a fun  and effective workout. If you encounter any issues please report it in the Training Mode Issues thread
    New Glove Adjustability - Hold the trigger buttons to rotate and adjust the controller inside the gloves in any angle you want
    Twice as many jumps (just joking… we removed them completely)   - Yes they are gone. We listened to you, eventually!
    A simplified tutorial - Visual cues aid the correct path for each move. We are improving it further in the next few weeks
    Oculus Rift Support - We are very pleased to finally offer support for Oculus. Oculus users please let us know of any issues in our Oculus Support thread


We have another major update planned in two weeks. Please keep your reviews, comments and feedback coming - as always your support is much appreciated!!
